description: Converts an amount between currencies at the European Central Bank reference rates (published each working day, via the Frankfurter API). Only the rate list is fetched; the amount stays on this machine.

to.description: ISO codes; leave out for RON, EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, HUF, PLN, CZK, SEK, NOK, DKK, TRY, JPY, CNY, CAD, AUD

title: Convert currencies
